name: Fine Mansion
desc1: This long, wide hallway has walls of a finely grained grey wood, and
desc2: the floors are a patterned black marble. Slightly disturbing statues
desc3: stand on short pedestals here, and odd portraits hanging from the
desc4: walls seem to stare at you with a life of their own. A wonderful
desc5: chandelier hangs from the ceiling here, made out of glittering crystal
desc6: and sporting a hundred glowing candles. The carpeted hallway leads out
desc7: to the north, and to the west looms a heavy, ornate oak door.
